about_the_game:
Elgracia: A Kingdom's Chronicle

The kingdom of Elgracia, once peaceful and prosperous, fell swiftly into ruin at the hands of the power-hungry Duke Legard. Young Princess Eileen was forced to flee, chased relentlessly by the duke's forces.

Just when all seemed lost, fate intervened. Fenrir, leader of a wandering mercenary company, and his companions appeared, lending her their strength.

From this unexpected encounter, a new hope was born.
Princess Eileen began her journey to reclaim her kingdom.

Elgracia: A Kingdom's Chronicle is a strategic RPG presented in nostalgic pixel art. Amidst political intrigue and conflict, you’ll journey with diverse and compelling allies, each with their own unique story and skills.

Experience deep, grid-based tactical turn-based combat that rewards thoughtful planning and precise decision-making. Build and strengthen your team of allies, uncovering the truth behind Elgracia’s downfall along the way.

  • Grid-based tactical turn-based battles

  • Deep and immersive, story-driven gameplay

  • Unique allies with diverse backgrounds and abilities

  • Rich gameplay content including crafting, cooking, quests, and more

  • Beautiful pixel-art visuals and an evocative soundtrack

A young princess, newfound allies, and a lost kingdom.
Will you join them in reshaping the fate of Elgracia?

  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon HD 7850 / Intel Iris Xe
